bundle_role: 04 — criterion-by-criterion independent acceptance review of what was actually received (zero raw bytes + the operator decision), with the four-way status vocabulary

status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: independently read back by Arena from bytes Arena holds (IRR/IPD Git object databases, read-only)
status_vocabulary.NOT VERIFIED: evidence was reported or previously captured, but identity/completeness/digest consistency cannot be established from bytes, or a prior affirmative mismatch stands uncured
status_vocabulary.NOT EVIDENCED: no evidence exists yet for the item (the attempt-session capture has not been made)
status_vocabulary.NOT APPLICABLE: the item does not apply at this stage/scope, or its deposit limb was closed by the operator supersession decision

exit_signals_still_not_proof.no_stop_txt: the published instrument defines Stop-Report and never calls it; a missing STOP.txt is expected in every run and is not a verdict
exit_signals_still_not_proof.zero_error_scan_matches: a limited pattern scan only shows those patterns did not match; it evaluates no PF item
exit_signals_still_not_proof.walkable_ancestor_chain: evidences walkability, not .git absence, not NTFS/non-sync/non-network predicates
exit_signals_still_not_proof.capture_files_existing: capture existence is not acceptance (§16.148/§16.149.8, reaffirmed §16.151.5)
exit_signals_still_not_proof.prose_summary: the operator prose transcription is input documentation, not raw host evidence (explicitly excluded by this review's instruction)
